scripts.tests:start: npm run wp-env:start && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/dws-framework-bootstrapper-test-plugin composer run-script packages-install
scripts.tests: npm run tests:start && npm run tests:unit && npm run tests:integration && npm run tests:end-to-end && npm run wp-env:stop
scripts.tests:integration: wp-env run tests-wordpress --env-cwd=project composer run-script tests:integration
scripts.tests:end-to-end: wp-env run tests-wordpress --env-cwd=project composer run-script tests:end-to-end
scripts.tests:export-db: wp-env run tests-cli wp db export project/tests/Support/Data/dump.sql
